articles.title: U.S. House's tax committee advances crypto tax bill in wake of Clarity Act loss
articles.snippet: The Digital Asset Tax Certainty Act would ease complicated tax burdens for everyday use of cryptocurrencies, though Trump's industry ties spurred some pushback.

articles.title: US lawmakers advance bill to lock Trump’s Bitcoin reserve into law
articles.snippet: The legislation seeks to codify Trump’s Bitcoin reserve policy, locking up Bitcoin acquired through civil and criminal forfeiture for 20 years.

articles.title: Fed Chair Implies Trump Is Only Half Right on the Economy Following Rate Hike
articles.snippet: Chair Kevin Warsh credited Trump's economy, then ignored his rate-cut wishes entirely.

articles.title: Wall Street Bets on Fed Rate Hike: Here's What It Means for Bitcoin, Bonds and Trump
articles.snippet: Nearly every major bank now expects the Fed to raise rates for the first time in three years. Markets have mostly priced it in, but the political fallout could run deeper than one hike.
